items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: I don't remember what Louis's name was. We used to call him Little Louis... he used to play Armstrong a lot of Louis's records and things, Louis's solos.

ctx.x: Lots of people didn't know that.

Oh, boy. Any musician, they were kind of afraid to come to Pittsburgh, because they could find their -- meet their match there, you know. I don't care what instrument you played, we were always running around and knock on the door of some trumpet player. And Little Louis, we used to call him, say, "Hey, Little Louis, there's a trumpet player from Fletcher Henderson's band who thinks he can blow." And Louis said, "Oh, yeah?" And he would take his horn right out, no case or nothing, just take his horn and run down…
